desc:
🥊 RAGDOLL BOXING 3D 🥊

Every punch is real physics. No two knockouts ever look the same.

Step on a square by any ring to fight another player. Nobody around? A sparring bot jumps in. Slip their punches, counter, and drop them 3 times to win.

PC: Left Right Arrow To Hook, R to Uppercut, F to Block, Q/Eto Weave, Ctrl to lean Back
Controller: L2 / R2 to Hook, R1 to Uppercut, L1 to Block
Mobile: Swipe to punch, tap the buttons to block and weave
Controls Are Customizable! 
Earn cash, level up and build your record to earn trails, hair styles, and sfx.
